task: security review of an edge function that issues order refunds with the service role key

roles.name: edge-fn-auth-path-tracer
roles.mission: Trace every auth path into the refund edge function and list which ones reach the service role key
acceptance: every auth path into the refund edge function is traced to the service role key or ruled out

roles.name: rls-policy-auditor
roles.mission: Audit the RLS policies on the refund and order tables and write fixes
acceptance: the refund and order table RLS policies reject an unauthorized request

roles.name: service-key-leak-hunter
roles.mission: Find where the service role key can leak from the refund function and patch it
acceptance: the service role key no longer leaks from the refund function's logs or responses

roles.name: exploit-repro-checker
roles.mission: Reproduce each refund exploit path against the patched function
criteria: no auth path reaches the service role key without an owner check
each reported refund exploit fails after the patch
